name: VT Code
headline: VT Code - Terminal Coding Agent
short_description: VT Code is a semantic coding agent that operates within the terminal. It enables developers and operations teams to write, debug, and maintain code more efficiently. The agent integrates with existing terminal workflows and supports multiple programming languages. It connects to version control systems and build tools for streamlined development processes.
author: vinhnx

sections.overview:
VT Code is a Rust-based semantic coding agent that operates natively in the terminal, providing developers and operations teams with an interactive environment for writing, debugging, and maintaining code. The agent supports 21+ LLM providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, and LM Studio, with a default Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro model offering 1M-token context. It integrates with version control systems and build tools through a rich tooling ecosystem that includes safe file operations, ripgrep search, code intelligence, and project indexing. VT Code emphasizes security with restricted shell sandboxing, tool guardrails, subprocess isolation, and comprehensive audit logging. The platform is extensible through Agent Skills, MCP protocol support, Zed ACP integration, and lifecycle hooks, enabling developers to create custom workflows and subagents for long-running autonomous tasks.
Automate code generation for common programming tasks using natural language prompts.
Integrate with various AI providers to enhance coding capabilities and provide intelligent suggestions.
Utilize built-in code analysis tools to refactor and optimize existing codebases.
Delegate specific tasks to subagents for focused code reviews or debugging processes.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/vinhnx/vtcode`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
